title: ClearPath Managed IT Services Tier Change Terms
content:
**Basis.** A ClearPath Managed IT Services tier change takes effect only from the client's signed change request.

**Effective date.** An upgrade to a higher-ranked tier takes effect on the first day of the calendar month after the signature. A downgrade to a lower-ranked tier takes effect only on the first day of a renewal term, because no tier allows a mid-term downgrade.

**New rate.** The clause "The new per-seat rate is the new tier's list fee per seat reduced by the new tier's term discount for the current term length, rounded half up to the cent; when the new tier does not offer the current term length, the discount of the longest term it offers that does not exceed the current term applies, or none if there is no such term" is **no longer in force** as a rule for every tier change. It no longer governs an upgrade from ClearPath Essentials to ClearPath Standard, which follows the Essentials upgrade schedule. Every other tier change keeps it: the new per-seat rate is the new tier's list fee per seat reduced by the new tier's term discount for the current term length, rounded half up to the cent, and when the new tier does not offer the current term length, the discount of the longest term it offers that does not exceed the current term applies, or none if there is no such term.

**Conditions.** The covered seats on the effective date must meet the new tier's minimum seats, and an upgrade to ClearPath Premier or ClearPath Enterprise needs an active Sentinel Managed Security subscription. A tier change may take effect only while the agreement status is active, as shown on the agreement's system record.

**Effects.** A tier change neither restarts the term nor changes the contracted seats, generates no onboarding fee, and is never prorated: the monthly fee of the effective month onward uses the new rate.

**Hypothetical cases for the rate clause as it still applies.**

| Move | Current term | Discount used | New rate |
|---|---|---|---|
| To a tier listed at 200.00 offering 24, 36 and 60 months | 36 months | the 36-month discount, say 5 percent | 190.00 |
| To the same tier | 12 months | none: the tier offers no term of 12 months or less | 200.00 |
| To a tier listed at 200.00 offering 36 and 60 months | 24 months | none: the tier offers no term of 24 months or less | 200.00 |
| To a tier listed at 200.00 offering 36 and 60 months | 60 months | the 60-month discount, say 7.5 percent | 185.00 |

superseded_clauses: The new seat_rate_usd is the new tier's seat_rate_list_usd reduced by the new tier's term_discount_pct for the current term_months, rounded half up to the cent; when the new tier does not offer the current term length, the discount of the longest term it offers that does not exceed the current term applies, or none if there is no such term.
